# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability or expose proof-of-
concept data, credentials, or private dataset content. Contact the repository
maintainer through the private reporting channel they designate.

Include a concise description, affected area, reproduction steps, impact, and
any safe mitigation you identified. Do not include secrets in the report.

## Scope and handling

The repository has no published response-time commitment, supported-version
policy, or bug-bounty program. Maintainers should assess reports privately before
public disclosure. Cloud configuration, Supabase RLS/Auth, Turnstile, and upload
controls are especially sensitive areas.
